description:
Configure the WooCommerce store identity and homepage settings. 

1. Navigate to Settings > General.
2. Change the Site Title to 'Artisan Crafts Studio'.
3. Change the Tagline to 'Handcrafted with Love'.
4. Set the Timezone to 'New York' (America/New_York).
5. Save changes.
6. Navigate to Pages > Add New and create two new pages: one titled 'Home' and one titled 'News'. Publish both pages.
7. Navigate to Settings > Reading.
8. Set 'Your homepage displays' to 'A static page'.
9. Select 'Home' for the Homepage and 'News' for the Posts page.
10. Save changes.
